personas.name: Dee Rahman
personas.headline: How Dee journals eats without performing them
personas.summary: Dee logs visits on phone, maps on a larger phone view, taste profile when reviewing the week — private beta sample screens.

day.title: Log a visit
day.text: Dee logs a Karachi lunch on her phone before the walk back — place, dish, a private rating, no performance for strangers.

day.title: Rate it
day.text: Same phone: she adjusts the rating while the taste is still honest, not after a week of forgetting.

day.title: Map
day.text: Map of eats on the phone shows where she has been; useful for her, not a public flex.

day.title: Taste profile
day.text: Taste profile at night is a quiet summary — what she actually likes, not what she thinks she should like.

day.title: Wishlist
day.text: Wishlist gets one pin for next weekend. The journal stays hers. Private beta screens, fictional visits.

day.text: After a family lunch Arsalan logs the visit on his phone — kid-friendly is a tag, not a guess next month.

day.title: Kid note
day.text: A short note on high chairs and noise lands in the same entry so the next booking is kinder.

day.title: Wishlist

day.title: Home

day.text: Between classes Noor logs a budget eat on her phone — cheap and good can both be true, and now it is written down.

day.title: Wishlist
day.text: Wishlist collects spots under her ceiling so Friday is not a coin-flip between expensive and regrettable.
